verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a SaaS payments and agentic-commerce platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents letting users or merchants choose where their data is stored. Store Sync's restriction to US-based customers in USD is a market-eligibility limit, not a residency control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
